title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
浙江鄉試錄序
聖天子臨御之二十有二年為嘉
靖癸卯浙江例選士于鄉巡
按監察御史舒汀司監臨焉
祗承
明詔崇正文體先是行部郡邑申
令閱材聿新棘院建協忠堂
===
以敦化源巡鹽御史陳策昭
德宣猷雅志章顯協謀用臧
於是兩浙髦俊雲從景附奮
其忠懷而盛于前聞乃咨訪
文學禮聘烜及教諭陳雍為
考試官教諭石銘蔡元偉陳
嘉言李可賢鄭天行王建中
punctuated:
浙江鄉試錄序

聖天子臨御之二十有二年，為嘉靖癸卯，浙江例選士于鄉。巡按監察御史舒汀司監臨焉，祗承明詔，崇正文體。先是，行部郡邑，申令閱材，聿新棘院，建協忠堂，以敦化源。巡鹽御史陳策昭德宣猷，雅志章顯，協謀用臧。於是兩浙髦俊雲從景附，奮其忠懷，而盛于前聞。乃咨訪文學，禮聘烜及教諭陳雍為考試官，教諭石銘、蔡元偉、陳嘉言、李可賢、鄭天行、王建中
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Zhejiang Provincial Examination

In the twenty-second year of the sagely Son of Heaven’s reign, the guimao year of Jiajing [1543], Zhejiang selected men through the Provincial Examination according to established practice. Shu Ting, the Investigating Censor serving as Regional Inspector, acted as Supervising Official. Reverently carrying out the illustrious imperial edict, he promoted correct literary style. Earlier, while touring the prefectures and counties under his jurisdiction, he had reiterated instructions and assessed talent, renovated the examination compound, and built the Hall of United Loyalty, thereby strengthening the source of moral transformation. Chen Ce, the Salt-inspecting Censor, made virtue manifest and proclaimed the imperial designs. His noble intentions shone forth, and their joint deliberations achieved good results.

Thus the outstanding men of the Liangzhe region gathered like clouds and followed like shadows, giving full expression to their loyal hearts in a flourishing display surpassing what had previously been heard of. Inquiries were then made to seek men of literary learning, and Xuan and Chen Yong, an Instructor, were courteously invited to serve as Examiners; the Instructors Shi Ming, Cai Yuanwei, Chen Jiayan, Li Kexian, Zheng Tianxing, and Wang Jianzhong …

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
孫棠為同考試官以左布政
使歐陽必進右參政江匯司
提調按察使盧蕙僉事黃光
昇司監試至于百執有司選
委具良規制條畫視昔加慎
乃八月七日入院進提學副
使孔天胤所簡士三千有奇
===
而三試之公遴明鑒崇雅黜
浮錄中式士姓名及其文以
獻錄成烜當序諸首乃颺言曰
惟兩浙禹貢揚州之域在昔
神禹敷土作貢東巡會稽以
朝諸侯得𢌿書告成功文命
覃敷物化明德浙之文運其
punctuated:
孫棠為同考試官，以左布政使歐陽必進、右參政江匯司提調，按察使盧蕙、僉事黃光昇司監試。至于百執有司，選委具良，規制條畫，視昔加慎。乃八月七日入院，進提學副使孔天胤所簡士三千有奇，而三試之，公遴明鑒，崇雅黜浮，錄中式士姓名及其文以獻。錄成，烜當序諸首，乃颺言曰：
惟兩浙，禹貢揚州之域。在昔神禹敷土作貢，東巡會稽以朝諸侯，得𢌿書告成功，文命覃敷，物化明德。浙之文運，其
translation_en:
…and Sun Tang were appointed Associate Examiners. Ouyang Bijin, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner, and Jiang Hui, Right Provincial Administration Vice Commissioner, were charged with the duties of Proctor; Lu Hui, Provincial Surveillance Commissioner, and Huang Guangsheng, Assistant Surveillance Commissioner, were charged with overseeing the examinations. All other functionaries selected and assigned were capable men, and the regulations and detailed arrangements were drawn up with greater care than before. On the seventh day of the eighth month, we entered the examination compound and admitted the more than three thousand candidates selected by Kong Tianyin, Vice Surveillance Commissioner for Education. We examined them in three sessions, selecting impartially and judging discerningly, honoring refined writing and rejecting superficiality. The names of the successful candidates and their essays were recorded for presentation. When the record was completed, it fell to me, Xuan, to write a preface at its beginning. I therefore proclaim:
The Two Zhe constituted the territory of Yangzhou described in the Tribute of Yu. In ancient times, the divine Yu laid out the lands and established their tribute obligations. He traveled east to Kuaiji to receive the feudal lords in audience, received a document [?], and announced the successful completion of his work. His civilizing commands spread far and wide, and all beings were transformed by his luminous virtue. As for Zhejiang’s literary fortunes, might their…

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
肇始乎殷周以還播敎育材
設科取士雖風猷靡同而江
左文物益彬彬然盛矣及宋
儒朱熹倡道講業於兹而楊
時張栻呂祖謙諸子後先究
繹理學以維世敎以淑人心
居然有鄒魯之風我
===
聖祖受
命建極首定科舉尊用儒術是時
元勳碩輔乘運而起如宋濂
之宏才積學劉基之運籌決
謀王禕之博文陶凱之典樂
俱産自越鄉冠名當世今
皇上神聖中興憲經崇古躬帥道
punctuated:
肇始乎？殷周以還，播敎育材，設科取士，雖風猷靡同，而江左文物益彬彬然盛矣。及宋儒朱熹倡道講業於兹，而楊時、張栻、呂祖謙諸子後先究繹理學，以維世敎，以淑人心，居然有鄒魯之風。
我聖祖受命建極，首定科舉，尊用儒術。是時元勳碩輔乘運而起，如宋濂之宏才積學、劉基之運籌決謀、王禕之博文、陶凱之典樂，俱産自越鄉，冠名當世。
今皇上神聖中興，憲經崇古，躬帥道
translation_en:
…might this have been its beginning? From the Yin and Zhou dynasties onward, teaching was disseminated, talent nurtured, and examinations established to select men for office. Although prevailing customs and guiding principles differed, the cultural achievements of Jiangzuo flourished ever more splendidly. When the Song scholar Zhu Xi promoted the Way and taught here, Yang Shi, Zhang Shi, Lü Zuqian, and other masters successively investigated and expounded the Learning of Principle, sustaining moral teaching in society and improving people’s hearts. The region truly acquired the ethos of Zou and Lu, the homelands of Mencius and Confucius.
Our sagely founding ancestor received Heaven’s mandate and established the supreme standard of rule. Among his first acts, he established the civil-service examinations and honored and employed Confucian learning. At that time, eminent founding servants and great ministers arose in response to the age: Song Lian, with his broad talents and accumulated learning; Liu Ji, with his strategic planning and decisive counsel; Wang Yi, with his extensive literary learning; and Tao Kai, with his direction of ritual music. All were natives of the Yue region, and their reputations stood foremost in their time.
Now His Majesty, in his divine sagacity, has brought about a restoration. Taking the Classics as his model and venerating antiquity, he personally leads through the Way…

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
德以化成天下諸士沐浴膏
澤衣被
烈光亦有年矣利用奮庸不有
可徵者乎嘗讀崧高之詩曰
惟嶽降神生甫及申夫人才
雖關氣運而山川靈異不可
誣也恒嘗底震澤過錢塘泛
===
三江大海湖藪暎帶波流環
繞奇偉大觀煙雲杳靄之間
浩浩然無窮又嘗陟南鎮遊
四明登天台鴈蕩入于括蒼
峯巒鬱翠奧區神臯連岡千
里乃歎曰雄勝哉此兩儀之
神功五行之秀氣也其甲於
punctuated: 德以化成天下。諸士沐浴膏澤，衣被烈光，亦有年矣。利用奮庸，不有可徵者乎？嘗讀《崧高》之詩曰：「惟嶽降神，生甫及申。」夫人才雖關氣運，而山川靈異不可誣也。恒嘗底震澤，過錢塘，泛三江、大海，湖藪暎帶，波流環繞，奇偉大觀。煙雲杳靄之間，浩浩然無窮。又嘗陟南鎮，遊四明，登天台、鴈蕩，入于括蒼，峯巒鬱翠，奧區神臯，連岡千里。乃歎曰：「雄勝哉！此兩儀之神功、五行之秀氣也，其甲於
translation_en:
…virtue, thereby transforming and perfecting all under Heaven. The scholars have bathed in imperial bounty and been clothed in its brilliant radiance for many years now. Surely there is evidence of their fitness for employment and readiness to render service? I once read in the poem Lofty Mountains (Song gao): “The sacred peaks sent down their spirits, giving birth to Fu and Shen.” Although human talent is bound up with the movements of cosmic forces, the spiritual potency of mountains and rivers cannot be denied.

I, Heng, once reached Zhenze, passed through Qiantang, and sailed upon the Three Rivers and the great sea. Lakes and marshes reflected and bordered one another; waves and currents wound around them—a magnificent spectacle. Amid dim clouds and mist, the vast expanse stretched without end. I also climbed the Southern Guardian mountain, roamed Siming, ascended Tiantai and Yandang, and entered Kuocang. Peaks rose in luxuriant green; secluded places and sacred heights formed ridges extending a thousand li. Then I exclaimed: “How majestic and splendid! This is the wondrous work of Heaven and Earth, the finest vital energies of the Five Phases. Surely it ranks foremost among…”

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
天下者乎故盤鬱之氣鍾美
俊材以爲
國家登庸非偶然者今錄其文
率平正典則莊重簡雅渾厚
博大與山嶽同其氣昌以和
其詞雄以深渢渢洋洋與江
海同皆菁莪棫樸之功克楨
===
以寧之具也人文其盛矣乎
夫文也者所以經綸天地綱
維古今飾德表行宣明憲度
而啓迪民彜故因文見道脩
辭立誠士子成身信不專於
詞章已也道德仁義之訓佩
服在躬然或不遇其時往往
punctuated:
天下者乎？故盤鬱之氣，鍾美俊材，以爲國家登庸，非偶然者。今錄其文，率平正典則，莊重簡雅，渾厚博大，與山嶽同；其氣昌以和，其詞雄以深，渢渢洋洋，與江海同。皆《菁莪》《棫樸》之功，克楨以寧之具也。人文其盛矣乎！
夫文也者，所以經綸天地，綱維古今，飾德表行，宣明憲度，而啓迪民彜。故因文見道，脩辭立誠，士子成身，信不專於詞章已也。道德仁義之訓，佩服在躬，然或不遇其時，往往
translation_en:
…might they rank foremost under Heaven? Thus the densely gathered vital energies concentrate their excellence in outstanding men of talent, whom the state raises to office: this is no mere accident. The writings now recorded are generally balanced and correct, conforming to classical standards; dignified, concise, and elegant; substantial and capacious, sharing the character of the mountains. Their spirit is vigorous yet harmonious, their language powerful yet profound; flowing abundantly and expansively, they resemble the rivers and seas. All are the fruit of nurturing talent celebrated in “Luxuriant Southernwood” (Jing e) and “The Oak and the Thorn” (Yu pu), and furnish men capable of serving as pillars to secure peace. How flourishing is this literary culture!
Writing is the means by which Heaven and Earth are ordered, past and present held together, virtue adorned and conduct made manifest, laws and standards proclaimed and clarified, and the people enlightened concerning their constant moral principles. Thus through writing one perceives the Way, and through refining language one establishes sincerity. In bringing themselves to maturity, scholars assuredly do not concern themselves solely with literary composition. They embrace and embody the teachings of the Way, virtue, benevolence, and righteousness; yet some fail to encounter a favorable age and often…

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
恨不得用
今制度監三代而備禮樂當百
年而興
皇道炳煥
帝載緝熈諸士遭遇全盛千載一
時靖獻圖報不端自今日始
哉雖然諸士之文盛矣而君
===
子竊有懼焉懼夫文勝而流
之弊也必德昭而信成物軌
而行著而後校文者無失言
選士者無後憂焉敷奏之道
矢音之誼由此其選也矧宣
治采風不救其弊蔑以紀矣
夫救文之弊則莫如忠懷忠
punctuated:
恨不得用。
今制度監三代而備，禮樂當百年而興，皇道炳煥，帝載緝熈。諸士遭遇全盛，千載一時，靖獻圖報，不端自今日始哉？雖然，諸士之文盛矣，而君子竊有懼焉，懼夫文勝而流之弊也。必德昭而信成，物軌而行著，而後校文者無失言，選士者無後憂焉。敷奏之道，矢音之誼，由此其選也。矧宣治采風，不救其弊，蔑以紀矣。夫救文之弊，則莫如忠。懷忠
translation_en:
…lament that they cannot put their abilities to use.
Now institutions, taking the Three Dynasties as their model, have attained completeness; rites and music flourish as the dynasty reaches its hundredth year. The imperial Way shines brilliantly, and imperial undertakings advance in unbroken splendor. You scholars have encountered an age of consummate flourishing, an opportunity that comes once in a thousand years. Should not your devoted service and your plans to repay imperial favor begin this very day [?]? Yet, flourishing though your literary accomplishments are, the gentleman privately harbors a fear: that literary polish may predominate and lead to excess. Only when virtue shines forth and trustworthiness is established, when affairs follow proper standards and conduct becomes manifest, will those who assess compositions make no mistaken pronouncements and those who select scholars have no subsequent cause for concern. The proper way of presenting reports and the meaning of offering songs find their selection here [?]. Moreover, in making good governance known and collecting local songs, unless these abuses are remedied, there will be nothing worth recording. Now, nothing remedies the abuses of literary polish better than loyalty. Cherishing loyalty…

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
以事君而其用不匱也然非
先定其志崇本茂實以用於
世將不有靜言而庸違者歟
爾諸士膺茲舉也諸執事固
以協忠進之矣尚期同體斯
義秉虔以慎始敦厚以慮終
以振無前之績以樹無疆之
===
休為我
國家溥大同之化庶為賓興稱
重毋自諉也主司與諸士實
相與以有成者故于其始進
也竊附以人事
君之義為多士告焉是役也防範
於外振起文教則有若右布
punctuated:
以事君，而其用不匱也。然非先定其志，崇本茂實，以用於世，將不有靜言而庸違者歟？爾諸士膺茲舉也，諸執事固以協忠進之矣。尚期同體斯義，秉虔以慎始，敦厚以慮終，以振無前之績，以樹無疆之休，為我國家溥大同之化，庶為賓興稱重，毋自諉也。主司與諸士實相與以有成者，故于其始進也，竊附以人事君之義，為多士告焉。

是役也，防範於外，振起文教，則有若右布
translation_en:
…to serve the ruler, and its usefulness will never be exhausted. Yet unless they first firmly establish their aspirations, honor the root, and cultivate substantial accomplishments for service in the world, will there not be some whose words are fair but whose conduct runs counter to them? You scholars have been selected on this occasion, and the officials responsible have indeed advanced you in a shared spirit of loyalty. We further hope that you will together embody this principle: maintain reverence so as to be cautious at the beginning, and cultivate sincerity and generosity so as to consider the outcome. Thus may you accomplish unprecedented deeds, establish boundless blessings, and spread throughout our state the transforming influence of Great Unity. In this way you may lend due weight to the selection and ceremonial reception of worthy men. Do not evade your responsibilities. Those presiding over the examination and you scholars truly depend upon one another for success. Thus, at the outset of your advancement, I venture to append these words on the duty of a person serving his ruler [?], as an admonition to you all.

In this undertaking, those who maintained safeguards outside and invigorated literary education included the Right Provincial Administration Commissioner …

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
政使婁志德左叅政劉佐右
叅政馬紀右叅議郊鼎副使
鄒堯臣張一厚歐陽清僉事
艾希淳黃德純康朗而都指
揮傅啓忠韓平劉鼎張典李
鍪又皆以武事而賛成者也
有事玆土樂觀盛典則有若
戶部郎中陸子明主事鄭富
兵部主事韓柱工部員外郎
周南南京戶部主事洪朝選
其先期入
賀則有副使邢第左叅議高翀
均有翊賛之勞故備書云
山東濟南府德州儒學學正
punctuated:
政使婁志德、左叅政劉佐、右叅政馬紀、右叅議郊鼎、副使鄒堯臣、張一厚、歐陽清、僉事艾希淳、黃德純、康朗，而都指揮傅啓忠、韓平、劉鼎、張典、李鍪，又皆以武事而賛成者也。有事玆土，樂觀盛典，則有若戶部郎中陸子明、主事鄭富、兵部主事韓柱、工部員外郎周南、南京戶部主事洪朝選。其先期入賀，則有副使邢第、左叅議高翀，均有翊賛之勞，故備書云。
山東濟南府德州儒學學正
translation_en:
…Right Provincial Administration Commissioner Lou Zhide; Left Administration Vice Commissioner Liu Zuo; Right Administration Vice Commissioner Ma Ji; Right Administration Assistant Commissioner Jiao Ding [?]; Surveillance Vice Commissioners Zou Yaochen, Zhang Yihou, and Ouyang Qing; and Surveillance Assistant Commissioners Ai Xichun, Huang Dechun, and Kang Lang. Regional Military Commissioners Fu Qizhong, Han Ping, Liu Ding, Zhang Dian, and Li Mou likewise all contributed to its successful completion through their military duties.
Those who had official business in this region and gladly witnessed this grand ceremony included Lu Ziming, Director in the Ministry of Revenue; Zheng Fu, Secretary in that ministry; Han Zhu, Secretary in the Ministry of War; Zhou Nan, Vice Director in the Ministry of Works; and Hong Chaoxuan, Secretary in the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue. Those who had gone to court ahead of time to offer congratulations included Surveillance Vice Commissioner Xing Di and Left Administration Assistant Commissioner Gao Chong. All rendered assistance, and therefore their names are recorded in full here.
Director of the Confucian School of Dezhou, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong …

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text: 陳烜謹序
punctuated: 陳烜謹序。
translation_en: …Chen Xuan respectfully composed this preface.

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試
監臨官
巡按浙江監察御史舒汀〔紹安福建侯官縣人乙未進士〕
提調官
浙江等處承宣布政使司左布政使歐陽必進〔任夫江西安福縣人丁丑進士〕
浙江等處承宣布政使司右參政江匯〔東之江西進賢縣人丙戌進士〕
監試官
浙江等處提刑按察司按察使盧蕙〔子貞直隸山陽縣人癸未進士〕
浙江等處提刑按察司僉事黃光昇〔明舉福建晋江縣人己丑進士〕
===
考試官
山東濟南府德州儒學學正陳烜〔士光福建莆田縣人甲午貢士〕
廣東廣州府順德縣儒學教諭陳雍〔效冉江西泰和縣人丁酉貢士〕
同考試官
山東兖州府東平州平陰縣儒學教諭石銘〔民憲福建長樂縣人甲午貢士〕
湖廣黃州府羅田縣儒學教諭蔡元偉〔伯瞻福建晋江縣人辛卯貢士〕
直隸大名府濬縣儒學教諭陳嘉言〔德卿河南祥符縣人丁酉貢士〕
直隸太平府繁昌縣儒學教諭李可賢〔應昌福建福清縣人辛卯貢士〕
江西南昌府新建縣儒學教諭鄭天行〔孔健福建閩縣人甲午貢士〕
punctuated:
嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試。

監臨官：巡按浙江監察御史舒汀〔紹安，福建侯官縣人，乙未進士〕。

提調官：浙江等處承宣布政使司左布政使歐陽必進〔任夫，江西安福縣人，丁丑進士〕。浙江等處承宣布政使司右參政江匯〔東之，江西進賢縣人，丙戌進士〕。

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
第壹塲
四書
子曰若聖與仁則吾豈敢抑爲之不厭誨
人不倦則可謂云爾已矣公西華曰正
唯弟子不能學也
誠者天之道也
乃若其情則可以爲善矣乃所謂善也若
夫爲不善非才之罪也惻隱之心人皆
有之羞惡之心人皆有之恭敬之心人
===
皆有之是非之心人皆有之惻隱之心
仁也羞惡之心義也恭敬之心禮也是
非之心智也仁義禮智非由外鑠我也
我固有之也弗思耳矣故曰求則得之
舍則失之或相倍蓰而無算者不能盡
其才者也詩曰天生蒸民有物有則民
之秉夷好是懿德孔子曰爲此詩者其
知道乎故有物必有則民之秉夷也故
好是懿德
punctuated:
第壹塲

四書

子曰：「若聖與仁，則吾豈敢？抑爲之不厭，誨人不倦，則可謂云爾已矣。」公西華曰：「正唯弟子不能學也。」

誠者，天之道也。

乃若其情，則可以爲善矣，乃所謂善也。若夫爲不善，非才之罪也。惻隱之心，人皆有之；羞惡之心，人皆有之；恭敬之心，人皆有之；是非之心，人皆有之。惻隱之心，仁也；羞惡之心，義也；恭敬之心，禮也；是非之心，智也。仁義禮智，非由外鑠我也，我固有之也，弗思耳矣。故曰：「求則得之，舍則失之。」或相倍蓰而無算者，不能盡其才者也。《詩》曰：「天生蒸民，有物有則。民之秉夷，好是懿德。」孔子曰：「爲此詩者，其知道乎！」故有物必有則；民之秉夷也，故好是懿德。
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

The Master said: “As for sagehood and benevolence, how would I dare claim them? Yet working toward them without growing weary and teaching others without tiring—this much may be said of me, and nothing more.” Gongxi Hua said: “It is precisely this that we disciples cannot learn to do.”

Sincerity is the Way of Heaven.

As for their inherent dispositions, people are capable of doing good; this is what is meant by calling human nature good. If they do what is not good, the fault does not lie in their native capacities. Everyone has a heart of compassion; everyone has a heart that feels shame and disapproves of wrongdoing; everyone has a heart of reverence and respect; everyone has a heart that distinguishes right from wrong. The heart of compassion is benevolence; the heart that feels shame and disapproves of wrongdoing is righteousness; the heart of reverence and respect is ritual propriety; the heart that distinguishes right from wrong is wisdom. Benevolence, righteousness, ritual propriety, and wisdom are not infused into me from outside: I inherently possess them, but simply fail to reflect upon them. Thus it is said: “Seek them and you will obtain them; abandon them and you will lose them.” That people differ from one another twofold, fivefold, or to an incalculable degree is because they fail to develop their native capacities fully. The Book of Odes says: “Heaven gives birth to the multitude of people; for every thing there is a norm. The people hold fast to their constant nature and cherish this excellent virtue.” Kongzi said: “The author of this ode surely understood the Way!” Thus, wherever there is a thing, there must be a norm; because the people hold fast to their constant nature, they cherish this excellent virtue.

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
易
乾元者始而亨者也利貞者性情也乾始
能以美利利天下不言所利大矣哉大
哉乾乎剛健中正純粹精也六爻發揮
旁通情也時乗六龍以御天也雲行雨
施天下平也
彖曰柔以時升巽而順剛中而應是以大
亨用見大人勿恤有慶也南征吉志行
也
===
安土敦乎仁故能愛
萬物出乎震震東方也齊乎巽巽東南也
齊也者言萬物之潔齊也離也者明也
萬物皆相見南方之卦也聖人南面而
聽天下嚮明而治蓋取諸此也坤也者
地也萬物皆致養焉故曰致役乎坤兌
正秋也萬物之所說也故曰說言乎兌
戰乎乾乾西北之卦也言陰陽相薄也
坎者水也正北方之卦也勞卦也萬物
punctuated:
易

乾元者，始而亨者也；利貞者，性情也。乾始能以美利利天下，不言所利，大矣哉！大哉乾乎！剛健中正，純粹精也。六爻發揮，旁通情也。時乗六龍，以御天也。雲行雨施，天下平也。

彖曰：「柔以時升，巽而順，剛中而應，是以大亨。用見大人，勿恤，有慶也。南征吉，志行也。」

安土敦乎仁，故能愛。

萬物出乎震，震，東方也。齊乎巽，巽，東南也。齊也者，言萬物之潔齊也。離也者，明也；萬物皆相見，南方之卦也。聖人南面而聽天下，嚮明而治，蓋取諸此也。坤也者，地也；萬物皆致養焉，故曰致役乎坤。兌，正秋也，萬物之所說也，故曰說言乎兌。戰乎乾，乾，西北之卦也，言陰陽相薄也。坎者，水也，正北方之卦也，勞卦也，萬物
translation_en:
Book of Changes (Yijing)

Qian’s primal power is that which initiates and brings things to fulfillment; its power to benefit and remain steadfast is its inherent nature and disposition. Qian initiates things and can benefit all under Heaven with its excellent benefits, without specifying what it benefits. How great it is! Great indeed is Qian! Firm and vigorous, central and correct, it is pure, unmixed, and quintessential. Its six lines unfold and extend, comprehensively communicating the true conditions of things. In due season it rides the six dragons to command Heaven. Clouds move and rain falls, and all under Heaven is brought into harmony.

The Commentary on the Judgment says: “The yielding rises in due season; gentle and compliant, with the firm occupying the central position and finding a response, it therefore achieves great fulfillment. ‘It is fitting to see the great man; do not be anxious’: there will be cause for celebration. ‘To advance southward is auspicious’: one’s purpose will be carried out.”

Being content where one dwells and steadfast in benevolence, one can therefore love.

The myriad things emerge in Zhen; Zhen is the east. They become ordered in Xun; Xun is the southeast. ‘Becoming ordered’ means that the myriad things become trim and orderly. Li means brightness: the myriad things all become visible to one another; it is the trigram of the south. The sage faces south to hear the affairs of all under Heaven, turning toward the light to govern; this practice is surely derived from this. Kun is the earth: the myriad things all receive nourishment from it. Hence the saying, ‘They are served through Kun.’ Dui is autumn proper, in which the myriad things rejoice. Hence the saying, ‘They rejoice in Dui.’ ‘They contend in Qian’: Qian is the trigram of the northwest, signifying that yin and yang press against one another. Kan is water, the trigram of due north, the trigram of toil. The myriad things …

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
之所歸也故曰勞乎坎艮東北之卦也
萬物之所成終而所成始也故曰成言
乎艮
書
無曠庶官天工人其代之天敘有典勅我
五典五惇哉天秩有禮自我五禮有庸
哉同寅協恭和衷哉天命有德五服五
章哉天討有罪五刑五用哉政事懋哉
懋哉
===
臣爲上爲德爲下爲民
次五曰建用皇極
懋昭周公之訓惟民其乂我聞曰至治馨
香感于神明黍稷非馨明德惟馨爾尚
式時周公之猷訓惟日孜孜無敢逸豫
凡人未見聖若不克見既見聖亦不克
由聖爾其戒哉爾惟風下民惟草圖厥
政莫或不艱有廢有興出入自爾師虞
庶言同則繹爾有嘉謀嘉猷則入告爾
punctuated:
之所歸也，故曰「勞乎坎」。艮，東北之卦也，萬物之所成終而所成始也，故曰「成言乎艮」。

書

無曠庶官，天工人其代之。天敘有典，勅我五典，五惇哉！天秩有禮，自我五禮，有庸哉！同寅協恭，和衷哉！天命有德，五服五章哉！天討有罪，五刑五用哉！政事懋哉！懋哉！

臣爲上爲德，爲下爲民。

次五曰：「建用皇極。」

懋昭周公之訓，惟民其乂。我聞曰：「至治馨香，感于神明。黍稷非馨，明德惟馨。」爾尚式時周公之猷訓，惟日孜孜，無敢逸豫。凡人未見聖，若不克見；既見聖，亦不克由聖。爾其戒哉！爾惟風，下民惟草。圖厥政，莫或不艱。有廢有興，出入自爾師虞。庶言同，則繹。爾有嘉謀嘉猷，則入告爾
translation_en:
…is where all things return; hence it is said, “They toil in Kan.” Gen is the trigram of the northeast, where all things reach their completion and take their beginning; hence it is said, “They come to completion in Gen.”

Book of Documents

Let none of the many offices go unfilled: human beings must perform Heaven’s work in its stead. Heaven has established the constant relationships in their proper order; make our five constant duties correct, and let all five be earnestly observed! Heaven has established the ceremonial distinctions; let our five rites proceed from these and be regularly practiced! Be united in reverence, cooperate in respect, and be harmonious at heart! Heaven appoints those who possess virtue: let the five kinds of robes distinguish the five ranks! Heaven punishes the guilty: let the five punishments be applied in their five appropriate ways! Be diligent in the affairs of government! Be diligent!

A minister, in serving those above, serves virtue; in serving those below, serves the people.

The fifth is called: “Establish and employ the sovereign standard.”

Strive to make manifest the instructions of the Duke of Zhou, and the people will be well governed. I have heard it said: “The fragrance of perfect government reaches the spirits. It is not millet that is fragrant; only manifest virtue is fragrant.” May you follow these counsels and instructions of the Duke of Zhou, working diligently every day and never daring to indulge in ease or pleasure. People, before they have seen a sage, act as though they cannot attain the sight of one; yet after seeing a sage, they still cannot follow him. Be on your guard against this! You are the wind; the common people are the grass. In planning your government, regard no matter as free of difficulty. Whether abolishing or instituting something, consult your many officers in what you reject or adopt. When their various opinions agree, then examine the matter thoroughly. If you have good plans and good counsels, enter and report them to your …

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
后于內爾乃順之于外曰斯謀斯猷惟
我后之德嗚呼臣人咸若時惟良顯哉
王曰君陳爾惟弘周公丕訓無依勢作
威無倚法以削寬而有制從容以和
詩
二之日其同載纘武功言私其豵獻豜于
公
樂只君子邦家之基
篤公劉于京斯依蹌蹌濟濟俾筵俾几旣
===
登乃依乃造其曹執豕于牢酌之用匏
食之飲之君之宗之
聖敬日躋昭假遲遲上帝是祗
春秋
春正月公狩于郎桓公四年
春王正月公會王人齊侯宋公衞侯許男
曹伯陳世子款盟于洮僖公八年夏公
會宰周公齊侯宋子衞侯鄭伯許男曹
伯于葵丘僖公九年
punctuated:
后于內，爾乃順之于外，曰：「斯謀斯猷，惟我后之德。」嗚呼！臣人咸若時，惟良顯哉！王曰：「君陳，爾惟弘周公丕訓，無依勢作威，無倚法以削，寬而有制，從容以和。」

詩
二之日其同，載纘武功。言私其豵，獻豜于公。
樂只君子，邦家之基。
篤公劉，于京斯依。蹌蹌濟濟，俾筵俾几。旣登乃依，乃造其曹。執豕于牢，酌之用匏。食之飲之，君之宗之。
聖敬日躋，昭假遲遲，上帝是祗。

春秋
春正月，公狩于郎。桓公四年。
春王正月，公會王人、齊侯、宋公、衞侯、許男、曹伯、陳世子款，盟于洮。僖公八年。夏，公會宰周公、齊侯、宋子、衞侯、鄭伯、許男、曹伯于葵丘。僖公九年。
translation_en:
…to your ruler within the court; then carry it out beyond the court, saying, “These plans and counsels are the virtue of our ruler.” Ah! If ministers all acted thus, how excellent and illustrious they would be! The king said, “Jun Chen, you must extend the Duke of Zhou’s great teachings. Do not rely on power to intimidate, or on the law to exact oppressive levies. Be lenient, yet maintain order; be composed, and bring about harmony.”

The Book of Odes
In the second month they assemble, continuing their training in arms. They keep the young boars for themselves and present the mature boars to their lord.
How happy is the noble man, the foundation of the state and its ruling house!
Faithful Gong Liu settled upon the hill. Dignified and orderly were his followers; he had mats and armrests set out for them. Once they had ascended and taken their places, he went to their gathering. A pig was taken from the pen, and drink was poured with gourds. He fed them and gave them drink; they acknowledged him as their lord and clan head.
His sagely reverence rose daily; his radiant virtue reached far and endured. He revered the Lord on High.

The Spring and Autumn Annals
In spring, in the first month, the duke hunted at Lang. Fourth year of Duke Huan.
In spring, in the first month of the royal calendar, the duke met with a representative of the king, the Marquis of Qi, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Wei, the Baron of Xu, the Earl of Cao, and Kuan, heir apparent of Chen, and they made a covenant at Tao. Eighth year of Duke Xi.
In summer, the duke met with the Duke of Zhou, the chief minister, the Marquis of Qi, the heir of Song, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Zheng, the Baron of Xu, and the Earl of Cao at Kuiqiu. Ninth year of Duke Xi.

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
春王正月公及齊侯平莒及郯莒人不肯
公伐莒取向〔宣公四年〕夏公會齊侯伐
萊 秋公至自伐萊〔宣公七年〕
楚公子嬰齊帥師伐莒庚申莒潰楚人入
鄆〔成公九年〕
禮記
夫禮先王以承天之道以治人之情
是故聖人南面而立而天下大治
四暢交於中而發作於外
===
燔柴於泰壇祭天也瘞埋於泰折祭地也
用騂犢埋少牢於泰昭祭時也相近於
坎壇祭寒暑也王宮祭日也夜明祭月
也幽宗祭星也雩宗祭水旱也四坎壇
祭四方也山林川谷丘陵能出雲為風
雨見怪物皆曰神有天下者祭百神
第貳場
論
聖人合内外而成其仁
punctuated:
春，王正月，公及齊侯平莒及郯，莒人不肯，公伐莒，取向。〔宣公四年〕夏，公會齊侯伐萊。秋，公至自伐萊。〔宣公七年〕
楚公子嬰齊帥師伐莒。庚申，莒潰。楚人入鄆。〔成公九年〕
禮記
夫禮，先王以承天之道，以治人之情。
是故聖人南面而立，而天下大治。
四暢交於中，而發作於外。
燔柴於泰壇，祭天也；瘞埋於泰折，祭地也。用騂犢。埋少牢於泰昭，祭時也；相近於坎壇，祭寒暑也；王宮，祭日也；夜明，祭月也；幽宗，祭星也；雩宗，祭水旱也；四坎壇，祭四方也。山林、川谷、丘陵，能出雲、為風雨、見怪物，皆曰神。有天下者祭百神。
第貳場
論
聖人合内外而成其仁。
translation_en:
In spring, in the first month of the royal calendar, the Duke and the Marquis of Qi sought to reconcile Ju and Tan. The people of Ju refused. The Duke attacked Ju and captured Xiang. 〔Fourth year of Duke Xuan.〕 In summer, the Duke joined the Marquis of Qi in attacking Lai. In autumn, the Duke returned from the attack on Lai. 〔Seventh year of Duke Xuan.〕
Prince Yingqi of Chu led an army against Ju. On the gengshen day, Ju collapsed. The men of Chu entered Yun. 〔Ninth year of Duke Cheng.〕
Book of Rites
Ritual was what the former kings used to uphold the Way of Heaven and regulate human feelings.
Thus the sage stood facing south, and all under Heaven was well governed.
The four pervading influences [?] mingle within and manifest themselves outwardly.
Burning wood on the Great Altar is the sacrifice to Heaven; burying offerings at the Great Square Place is the sacrifice to Earth. A reddish calf is used. Burying a lesser animal offering—a sheep and a pig—at the Great Brightness is the sacrifice to the seasons. The rite called “xiangjin” [?], performed at pits and altars, is the sacrifice to cold and heat. The Royal Palace is where sacrifices are offered to the sun; the Brightness of Night, to the moon; the Dark Sanctuary, to the stars; the Rain Sanctuary, for floods and droughts; and the four pits and altars, to the four directions. Mountains and forests, rivers and valleys, hills and mounds that can send forth clouds, produce wind and rain, or manifest strange things are all called spirits. The possessor of all under Heaven sacrifices to the hundred spirits.
Second Session
Discourse
The sage unites the inner and the outer and thereby perfects his benevolence.

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
詔誥表內科一道
擬漢勸農桑禁采黃金珠玉詔景帝三年
擬唐加左僕射房玄齡太子少師誥貞觀
十三年
擬
大本堂成宴東宮官及儒士各
賜冠服謝表洪武元年
判語五條
舉用有過官吏
===
私剏庵觀及私度僧道
懸帶關防牌面
軍民約會詞訟
失時不修隄防
第叄場
策五道
問
聖祖讀洪範曰帝王爲治之要莫大於此自操
宸翰而精研其義演繹其說每置之左右朝夕
punctuated:
詔誥表內科一道。
擬漢勸農桑禁采黃金珠玉詔，景帝三年。
擬唐加左僕射房玄齡太子少師誥，貞觀十三年。
擬大本堂成，宴東宮官及儒士，各賜冠服謝表，洪武元年。
判語五條。
舉用有過官吏。
私剏庵觀及私度僧道。
懸帶關防牌面。
軍民約會詞訟。
失時不修隄防。
第叄場
策五道。
問：聖祖讀《洪範》，曰：「帝王爲治之要，莫大於此。」自操宸翰，而精研其義，演繹其說，每置之左右，朝夕
translation_en:
One topic from among edicts, proclamations, and memorials.

Compose an edict in the manner of the Han dynasty encouraging agriculture and sericulture and prohibiting the extraction of gold, pearls, and jade: the third year of Emperor Jing.

Compose a Tang-dynasty proclamation conferring on Fang Xuanling, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, the additional title of Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent: the thirteenth year of Zhenguan.

Compose a memorial of thanks for the banquet given to officials of the Heir Apparent’s household and Confucian scholars upon the completion of the Daben Hall, and for the caps and robes bestowed upon each: the first year of Hongwu.

Five legal judgments:

Recommending and appointing officials and clerks with previous offenses.

Privately establishing Buddhist hermitages and Daoist monasteries, and privately ordaining Buddhist monks and Daoist priests.

Wearing official identification plaques.

Military personnel and civilians arranging to bring lawsuits jointly.

Failing to repair dikes and embankments at the proper time.

Third Session

Five policy questions.

Question: The Sagely Founder read the Great Plan and said: “Among the essentials of imperial government, none is greater than this.” He personally took up the imperial brush, closely investigated its meaning, and elaborated its teachings. He regularly kept it beside him, morning and evening…

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
體驗而力行之心法相傳眞有得於堯
舜禹湯文武之統無復有加矣嘗考之
蔡氏季通父子曰易更四聖而象已著
範錫神禹而數不傳究箕子之疇先舉
其綱次條其目本末輕重之序天人感
應之幾數備而理精矣其欲傳之者何
數必立圖擬象方圓積運求與易準果
洛中則書之義乎揭始終立中極果極
之所以建亦極之所以行耶推而繼世
===
經緯立天以別地制人以任官均田以
睦俗辨分以成樂制兵以禁姦律曆稽
疑命筭任民斂財節用位國命邦該以
仲尼之九經曰所以行之者一而會歸
皇極之全蔡氏之演以發箕子未盡之
疇果一致同歸否耶我
成祖纂性理大全取蔡氏說頒庠序以示後世
聖神相傳之緒可得聞與
問易言建國親侯詩敘藩垣屏翰蓋以王
punctuated:
體驗而力行之，心法相傳，眞有得於堯舜禹湯文武之統，無復有加矣。嘗考之，蔡氏季通父子曰：「易更四聖而象已著，範錫神禹而數不傳。」究箕子之疇，先舉其綱，次條其目，本末輕重之序，天人感應之幾，數備而理精矣。其欲傳之者何數？必立圖擬象，方圓積運，求與易準，果洛中則書之義乎？揭始終，立中極，果極之所以建，亦極之所以行耶？推而繼世經緯，立天以別地，制人以任官，均田以睦俗，辨分以成樂，制兵以禁姦，律曆稽疑，命筭任民，斂財節用，位國命邦，該以仲尼之九經，曰：「所以行之者一。」而會歸皇極之全。蔡氏之演，以發箕子未盡之疇，果一致同歸否耶？我成祖纂《性理大全》，取蔡氏說，頒庠序以示後世，聖神相傳之緒，可得聞與？

問：易言建國親侯，詩敘藩垣屏翰，蓋以王
translation_en:
…he apprehended it through experience and put it earnestly into practice. Through the transmission of the teaching of the mind, he truly grasped the succession of Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Wen, and Wu; nothing further could be added. I have examined the statement of Cai Jitong and his son: “The Changes passed through four sages, and its images have been made manifest; the Great Plan was bestowed upon the divine Yu, yet its numbers were not transmitted.” Examining Jizi’s categories, they first set out the main framework and then arranged its particulars. In the ordering of root and branch, greater and lesser importance, and in the subtle workings of the mutual response between Heaven and humanity, the numbers are complete and the principles refined. What numbers, then, did they wish to transmit? They insisted upon establishing diagrams and modelling images, accumulating and cycling numbers through squares and circles, seeking to make these accord with the Changes. Is this truly the meaning of “the writing from within the Luo” [?]? By disclosing beginnings and endings and establishing the central standard, did they truly explain both how the standard is established and how it is put into practice? Extending this to the ordering of successive ages, they established Heaven to distinguish Earth, regulated people to appoint officials, equalized fields to harmonize customs, distinguished social divisions to perfect music, and instituted military forces to restrain wrongdoing. They treated pitch standards and calendrical calculation, the resolution of doubts, the determination of numerical reckonings [?], the assignment of duties to the people, the collection of revenue and restraint of expenditure, and the positioning of states and establishment of domains. They encompassed these within Zhongni’s nine guiding principles, saying, “That by which they are put into practice is one,” and brought them together within the completeness of the August Standard. Does the Cai family’s elaboration, intended to disclose what Jizi had left unexhausted in his categories, truly have the same purport and reach the same conclusion? Our Chengzu compiled the Complete Compendium of Human Nature and Principle, adopting the Cai family’s explanations, and distributed it to the schools to instruct later generations. May we hear an account of this thread of transmission among the sages and divine rulers?

Question: The Changes speaks of establishing states and drawing close to the feudal lords; the Odes describes fences, walls, screens, and supports. This is because a king…

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
者受命制法必封同姓以明親親封功
臣以彰賢賢用成屏翰之助固磐石之
宗三代以還皆此道也昔班固作漢書
各著諸侯王表又著王子功臣恩澤侯
表歷敘虞夏殷周之由所以示昭監者
詳矣抑合於古之道歟我
太祖封建親族首錄元功俱堅帶礪之盟上埒
虞周而下陋漢代矣其時親承
懿訓慎選輔導賢良輝映
===
國祚永休而今
本支繁衍祿食告乏則將何以給之王官輕
微輔導無功則將何以處之在昔元臣
輔
丕基而濟大業者功在
社稷歷歷可數而今世祿之子罕有先哲之
風豈太平日久無由而自見歟抑志習
因循不從事於學歟茲欲重英傑之選
未免長沙賈誼之嘆嚴舉察之條懼坐
punctuated: 者受命制法，必封同姓以明親親，封功臣以彰賢賢，用成屏翰之助，固磐石之宗。三代以還，皆此道也。昔班固作《漢書》，各著諸侯王表，又著王子功臣恩澤侯表，歷敘虞夏殷周之由，所以示昭監者詳矣。抑合於古之道歟？我太祖封建親族，首錄元功，俱堅帶礪之盟，上埒虞周，而下陋漢代矣。其時親承懿訓，慎選輔導，賢良輝映，國祚永休。而今本支繁衍，祿食告乏，則將何以給之？王官輕微，輔導無功，則將何以處之？在昔元臣輔丕基而濟大業者，功在社稷，歷歷可數。而今世祿之子，罕有先哲之風，豈太平日久，無由而自見歟？抑志習因循，不從事於學歟？茲欲重英傑之選，未免長沙賈誼之嘆；嚴舉察之條，懼坐
translation_en:
…when kings receive the mandate and establish institutions, they necessarily enfeoff men of their own surname to make manifest affection for kin, and enfeoff meritorious ministers to demonstrate esteem for the worthy. Thus they secure support as protective bulwarks and make the ruling lineage firm as a great rock. From the Three Dynasties onward, all followed this way. Formerly, when Ban Gu compiled the History of the Han, he separately composed tables of the feudatory kings, and also tables of kings’ sons, meritorious officials, and marquises ennobled by imperial favor. He recounted in sequence the precedents of Yu, Xia, Yin, and Zhou, providing detailed illustrations to serve as clear admonitory mirrors. Yet did these arrangements accord with the way of antiquity?

Our Taizu enfeoffed his kinsmen and gave foremost recognition to those whose achievements had founded the dynasty. With all of them he firmly established covenants enduring until the Yellow River became a belt and Mount Tai a whetstone. His arrangements equaled those of Yu and Zhou above, and made those of the Han below appear inferior. At that time, they personally received his gracious instructions; advisers and tutors were carefully selected, and worthy and good men lent one another luster, bringing lasting blessings to the dynasty’s fortunes. But now the main and collateral branches have multiplied, and resources for their stipends and sustenance are reportedly insufficient. How, then, are they to be provided for? Officials serving the princes have little standing, and their guidance achieves nothing. How, then, is this to be addressed?

In former times, the great founding ministers who supported the imperial foundation and brought the great enterprise to completion rendered services to the altars of soil and grain that can be distinctly enumerated. Yet today, descendants enjoying hereditary stipends rarely possess the character of their illustrious forebears. Is this because peace has lasted so long that they have no occasion to distinguish themselves? Or do their aspirations and habits follow established routines, without their applying themselves to learning? If we now wish to give greater weight to selecting outstanding men, we cannot escape the lament of Jia Yi of Changsha; if we tighten the provisions for recommendation and scrutiny, we fear incurring…

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
鼂錯首釁之愆則將何所裁歟申武學
以明韜略嚴武舉以重考課倣唐朝循
名實之制稽宋代察勳閥之議或可裨
於時歟
皇上推恩宗藩視昔加隆矣毎有
勅諭之頒重録功臣於前有光矣尤愼賞罰之
令仁義竝行所以納諸軌物以圖永貞
如天地之於萬物愛養而曲成之也此
古今大典也諸士子陳其義焉
===
問十三經註疏行於世者久矣廣矣總羣
書而録之為經始於何代易宗輔嗣而
江南疏義率本玄虛書祖皇甫而河朔
註釋咸歸淺略毛詩箋於鄭氏為之疏
者七家孰為特達左氏明於元凱為之
疏者三家孰為辨博公羊傳次何休之
學也其師作論解疑反致敗績穀梁集
解范甯之家傳也而所附名例未必通
方儀禮五傳而後暢鄭賈註疏其義已
punctuated:
鼂錯首釁之愆，則將何所裁歟？申武學以明韜略，嚴武舉以重考課，倣唐朝循名實之制，稽宋代察勳閥之議，或可裨於時歟？皇上推恩宗藩，視昔加隆矣，毎有勅諭之頒；重録功臣，於前有光矣，尤愼賞罰之令。仁義竝行，所以納諸軌物，以圖永貞，如天地之於萬物，愛養而曲成之也。此古今大典也，諸士子陳其義焉。

問：十三經註疏行於世者久矣，廣矣。總羣書而録之為經，始於何代？易宗輔嗣，而江南疏義率本玄虛；書祖皇甫，而河朔註釋咸歸淺略。毛詩箋於鄭氏，為之疏者七家，孰為特達？左氏明於元凱，為之疏者三家，孰為辨博？公羊傳次何休之學也，其師作論解疑，反致敗績；穀梁集解，范甯之家傳也，而所附名例未必通方。儀禮五傳而後暢，鄭賈註疏，其義已
translation_en:
…the offense of initiating discord, as Chao Cuo did—how, then, should the matter be adjudicated? Might it benefit our times to strengthen military education so as to elucidate strategy, tighten the Military Examinations so as to give greater weight to assessment, emulate the Tang dynasty’s system of examining both reputation and actual achievement, and consult the Song dynasty’s proposals for scrutinizing meritorious lineages?

His Majesty has extended favor to the imperial clan’s princely houses with greater generosity than in the past, repeatedly issuing imperial admonitions. His recognition of meritorious officials surpasses earlier precedent in its splendor, and he exercises particular care in his commands concerning rewards and punishments. Benevolence and righteousness operate together to bring them within proper norms and secure lasting rectitude, just as Heaven and Earth cherish and nurture the myriad things and bring each to fulfillment according to its nature. These are great institutions of past and present. Let you candidates expound their significance.

Question: The Commentaries and Subcommentaries on the Thirteen Classics have circulated in the world for a long time and over a wide area. In which dynasty did the gathering of these various books and their designation as classics begin? The scholarship of the Changes takes Fusi [Wang Bi] as its authority, yet the explanatory subcommentaries from Jiangnan are generally grounded in abstruse speculation about emptiness. Scholarship of the Documents follows Huangfu, yet the annotations from Heshuo all tend toward shallowness and brevity. Master Zheng supplied explanatory notes to the Mao Poetry; of the seven scholars who wrote subcommentaries, which was outstanding in insight? Yuankai [Du Yu] elucidated the Zuo Commentary; of the three scholars who wrote subcommentaries, which was discerning and comprehensive? The Gongyang Commentary follows He Xiu’s scholarship [?]; his teacher wrote a discourse to resolve doubts, yet instead suffered defeat [?]. The Collected Explanations of the Guliang Commentary transmits the learning of Fan Ning’s family, yet the appended discussion of terminology and interpretive conventions does not necessarily display comprehensive understanding. The Ceremonies and Rites became fully elucidated only after five transmissions; through the commentary and subcommentary of Zheng and Jia, its meaning had already…

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
明復有爲二百一十八圖以附之者周
禮歷後漢而始行或信或疑其議不一
復有爲十論七難以詆之者禮記二戴
分門而南北異派其獨尚皇熊何也孝
經百家遞述而古今異本其更相譏駁
何也論語集解於何晏而義說孰宗孟
子註於趙岐而音釋孰勝爾雅或言周
公所作或言仲尼所增郭景純乃言興
於中古隆於漢氏何以證之至唐孔穎
===
達著作正義博采前聞而於諸儒多所
譏駁亦自有見其大指可揚確乎否也
問周禮太宰總統百官論道經邦而六卿
與屬罔不承令是則然矣然王宮內之
事亦兼統並治其義何歟夫內外之間
自宜有限而大臣之專如此不幾於親
細事而攬威柄耶抑君明臣忠內外合
一事固不嫌於專也西漢建官自尚書
而下以至中書謁者大長秋之屬皆屬
punctuated:
明，復有爲二百一十八圖以附之者。周禮歷後漢而始行，或信或疑，其議不一，復有爲十論七難以詆之者。禮記二戴分門，而南北異派，其獨尚皇熊何也？孝經百家遞述，而古今異本，其更相譏駁何也？論語集解於何晏，而義說孰宗？孟子註於趙岐，而音釋孰勝？爾雅或言周公所作，或言仲尼所增，郭景純乃言興於中古，隆於漢氏，何以證之？至唐孔穎達著作正義，博采前聞，而於諸儒多所譏駁，亦自有見，其大指可揚確乎否也？

問：周禮太宰總統百官，論道經邦，而六卿與屬罔不承令，是則然矣。然王宮內之事亦兼統並治，其義何歟？夫內外之間，自宜有限，而大臣之專如此，不幾於親細事而攬威柄耶？抑君明臣忠，內外合一，事固不嫌於專也？西漢建官，自尚書而下，以至中書謁者、大長秋之屬，皆屬
translation_en:
… clear; there was also someone who produced 218 diagrams to append to it. The Rites of Zhou only began to circulate in the Later Han. Some accepted it and others doubted it, and opinions differed; there was also someone who composed ten arguments and seven objections to disparage it. The two Dai arranged the Record of Rites into sections, while northern and southern scholarship developed into different schools. Why were Huang and Xiong alone especially esteemed? Successive scholars of a hundred schools expounded the Classic of Filial Piety, yet its ancient-script and modern-script texts differed. Why did they criticize and refute one another? He Yan compiled the Collected Explanations of the Analects, but whose interpretations should be followed? Zhao Qi annotated the Mencius, but whose explanations of pronunciation and meaning are superior? Some say that the Literary Expositor (Erya) was composed by the Duke of Zhou; others say that Zhongni added to it. Guo Jingchun, however, said that it arose in middle antiquity and flourished under the Han. How can this be substantiated? In the Tang, Kong Yingda composed the Correct Meaning commentaries, drawing extensively on earlier learning while frequently criticizing and refuting other scholars. He also had insights of his own. Can their main purport be expounded and verified [?], or not?

Question: In the Rites of Zhou, the Grand Steward directs all officials, discusses the Way, and orders the state; the six ministers and their subordinates all obey his commands. This is indeed so. Yet he also oversees and administers affairs within the royal palace. What is the rationale for this? There should naturally be a boundary between inner and outer affairs. When a chief minister exercises such exclusive authority, does this not approach personally attending to petty matters and monopolizing power? Or, when the ruler is enlightened and the minister loyal, and inner and outer affairs form a single whole, is there inherently no objection to concentrating responsibility in this way? In establishing offices, the Western Han made all officials, from the Masters of Writing down to such officers as the Palace Secretariat Receptionists and the Chamberlain for the Empress, subordinate to …

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
之少府而丞相御史大夫居外中丞居
殿中蘭臺東漢則取三公之官以爲閣
職而取尚書及中丞以爲臺閣之長以
舉法歸中書而以奏事歸尚書其視西
漢又稍不同然于周禮之意果孰爲近
乎迨夫宦官典中書之任中丞無制事
之權三公失加官之號大將軍領尚書
之職而御史丞相之司日以閼隔漢事
遂日以非豈盡亡周禮之遺意故耶抑
===
別有其說也夫宮中府中其體一兼統
竝治其意深諸士亦有問禮問官而得
其旨者乎願相與發明之
問識時務者在俊傑今時務最切者莫重
邊事蓋自秦漢而下四夷之患唯西北
最甚我
太祖高皇帝驅逐胡元肇造區夏
成祖文皇帝大定險艱業備創守自遼薊宣大
及延寧固肅凡爲九邊形勢不同防禦
punctuated:
之少府，而丞相、御史大夫居外，中丞居殿中蘭臺。東漢則取三公之官以爲閣職，而取尚書及中丞以爲臺閣之長，以舉法歸中書，而以奏事歸尚書，其視西漢又稍不同。然于周禮之意，果孰爲近乎？迨夫宦官典中書之任，中丞無制事之權，三公失加官之號，大將軍領尚書之職，而御史丞相之司日以閼隔，漢事遂日以非，豈盡亡周禮之遺意故耶？抑別有其說也？夫宮中府中，其體一；兼統竝治，其意深。諸士亦有問禮問官而得其旨者乎？願相與發明之。

問：識時務者在俊傑。今時務最切者，莫重邊事。蓋自秦漢而下，四夷之患唯西北最甚。我太祖高皇帝驅逐胡元，肇造區夏；成祖文皇帝大定險艱，業備創守。自遼薊宣大及延寧固肅，凡爲九邊，形勢不同，防禦
translation_en:
…under the Chamberlain for the Palace Revenues, while the Grand Councilor and Censor-in-Chief served outside the palace, and the Palace Assistant Imperial Clerk served at the Orchid Terrace within it. In the Eastern Han, officials of the Three Dukes were assigned cabinet duties, while the Masters of Writing and the Palace Assistant Imperial Clerk were made heads of the central bureaus; responsibility for enforcing the law was assigned to the Palace Secretariat, and that for submitting matters to the throne to the Masters of Writing [?]. This differed somewhat from the Western Han arrangements. Yet which was actually closer to the intent of the Rites of Zhou? When eunuchs took charge of the Palace Secretariat, the Palace Assistant Imperial Clerk lacked authority to decide affairs, the Three Dukes lost their supplementary official titles, and the General-in-Chief concurrently directed the Masters of Writing, the offices of the censors and Grand Councilor became increasingly obstructed and cut off. The affairs of the Han consequently went increasingly awry. Was this because every vestige of the intent of the Rites of Zhou had been lost? Or is there another explanation? The palace and the government offices form a single body; the intent behind their unified supervision and joint administration is profound. Have any of you gentlemen grasped this meaning through inquiries into ritual and official institutions? I hope that we may elucidate it together.

Question: Those who understand the pressing affairs of their age are men of outstanding ability. Among the most urgent affairs of the present, none is weightier than frontier matters. From the Qin and Han onward, the gravest troubles caused by the peoples beyond our borders have come from the northwest. Our Emperor Taizu Gao expelled the Mongol Yuan and founded his rule over the Chinese realm. Emperor Chengzu Wen brought great dangers and difficulties under control, accomplishing both the establishment and the preservation of the imperial undertaking. From Liao, Ji, Xuan, and Da to Yan, Ning, Gu, and Su, there are nine frontier commands in all. Their terrain and strategic circumstances differ, and their defenses…

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
各異而置帥屯兵城守皆重用圖久安
長治
聖神謨烈遐哉深矣自遼陽舊城及三衛棄去
東西限隔而遼陽宣薊遂稱多事其大
者取復舊地重黃花鎮修潮河川似不
可不講歟宣府山川險隘時勢既殊經
畫宜周若補長峪城謹浮圖峪似不容
已也大同川原平衍五堡雖已修築三
關尤爲要害其曰建東長峪修平定平
===
遠長勝諸堡固當務歟延綏邊堡襟帶
千里徙鎮榆林實得地利而隘口之防
芻糧之議固當計歟寧夏花馬池一帶
極爲虜衝今總督駐兵實爲得計而守
賀蘭山據鐵柱泉其先制之策歟甘肅
孤懸幾二千里自哈密陷土魯番
累朝大臣恢略竟不能收復城衛豈此舉在
所緩歟其復本色以給儲修嘉峪關以
備寇果在所先歟固原自火篩入掠之
punctuated: 各異，而置帥屯兵，城守皆重，用圖久安長治。聖神謨烈，遐哉深矣！自遼陽舊城及三衛棄去，東西限隔，而遼陽、宣薊遂稱多事。其大者，取復舊地，重黃花鎮，修潮河川，似不可不講歟？宣府山川險隘，時勢既殊，經畫宜周。若補長峪城，謹浮圖峪，似不容已也。大同川原平衍，五堡雖已修築，三關尤爲要害。其曰建東長峪，修平定、平遠、長勝諸堡，固當務歟？延綏邊堡襟帶千里，徙鎮榆林，實得地利，而隘口之防、芻糧之議，固當計歟？寧夏花馬池一帶，極爲虜衝，今總督駐兵，實爲得計，而守賀蘭山，據鐵柱泉，其先制之策歟？甘肅孤懸幾二千里，自哈密陷土魯番，累朝大臣恢略，竟不能收復城衛，豈此舉在所緩歟？其復本色以給儲，修嘉峪關以備寇，果在所先歟？固原自火篩入掠之
translation_en: …each differs, yet in all of them the appointment of commanders, the stationing of troops, and the defense of fortified cities receive great emphasis, with the aim of securing enduring peace and lasting order. How far-reaching and profound are the plans and achievements of our sagely sovereigns! Since the abandonment of the old city of Liaoyang and the Three Guards, east and west have been cut off from one another, and Liaoyang, Xuanfu, and Jizhou have consequently become known as troubled regions. Among the major measures—recovering the former territories, strengthening Huanghua Zhen, and repairing the defenses of Chaohe Chuan—does it not seem essential to discuss these? Xuanfu has rugged mountains and rivers and narrow passes. As the circumstances of the times have changed, planning should be comprehensive. Measures such as repairing the walls of Changyu and maintaining vigilant defenses at Futu Yu would seem indispensable. Datong has broad, level plains. Although the Five Forts have already been repaired, the Three Passes are particularly critical strategic points. As for the proposals to build defenses at Dongchangyu and repair the forts of Pingding, Pingyuan, and Changsheng, are these not indeed urgent tasks? The frontier forts of Yansui form a defensive belt extending a thousand li. Moving the garrison headquarters to Yulin truly secured an advantageous position; but should not the defense of the passes and proposals concerning fodder and grain also be carefully considered? The area around Huamachi in Ningxia lies directly on the enemy’s invasion route. The supreme commander’s present stationing of troops there is indeed sound policy; but might defending Helan Shan and occupying Tiezhu Quan constitute a strategy for forestalling the enemy? Gansu stretches in isolation for nearly two thousand li. Since Hami fell to Turfan, the recovery plans of high officials under successive reigns have ultimately failed to recover the city and its guard. Can this undertaking be deferred? As for restoring payments in kind to replenish the stores and repairing Jiayu Guan to guard against raiders, should these truly take precedence? At Guyuan, since Huoshai’s incursion and plundering…

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
後蘭靖安會之間俱受先害西鳳臨鞏
之民多未經戰其添堡屯兵所當急圖
者歟近者胡虜猖獗屢犯雲中寇三晉
至震驚中原今邊報雖息尚厪
宵旰之憂其戰守上策議者謂選將帥足兵
食設關險嚴烽堠遠間諜招降順激勇
敢速調發重守令明法制之類內外諸
臣各有建白當何施而可使九邊晏如
也諸士平日運籌久矣其據實敷言務
===
切時政用見經國之猷效忠之願毋徒
曰軍旅之事未之學也
punctuated: 後，蘭靖安會之間俱受先害，西鳳臨鞏之民多未經戰，其添堡屯兵所當急圖者歟？近者胡虜猖獗，屢犯雲中，寇三晉，至震驚中原。今邊報雖息，尚厪宵旰之憂。其戰守上策，議者謂選將帥、足兵食、設關險、嚴烽堠、遠間諜、招降順、激勇敢、速調發、重守令、明法制之類，內外諸臣各有建白，當何施而可使九邊晏如也？諸士平日運籌久矣，其據實敷言，務切時政，用見經國之猷、效忠之願，毋徒曰軍旅之事未之學也。
translation_en: …afterward, the areas of Lan, Jing, An, and Hui all suffered the first blows, while the people of Xi, Feng, Lin, and Gong have mostly not experienced warfare. Should adding forts and stationing troops there therefore be urgently planned? Recently the northern tribes have run rampant, repeatedly invading Yunzhong and raiding the Three Jin regions, to the point of alarming the Central Plain. Although reports of border alarms have now ceased, they still trouble His Majesty, who rises before dawn and eats late in his concern for affairs of state. As for the best strategies for fighting and defense, those discussing the matter propose such measures as selecting commanders, ensuring sufficient troops and provisions, establishing fortified passes at strategic points, tightening precautions at beacon towers, sending spies far afield, welcoming those who surrender and submit, encouraging the brave, expediting troop mobilization, giving greater weight to prefects and magistrates, and making laws and regulations clear. Officials at court and in the provinces have each submitted proposals. What measures should be implemented to bring tranquility to the Nine Border Commands? You candidates have long pondered strategy in your daily lives. Set out your views on the basis of actual conditions, making them directly relevant to current affairs, thereby demonstrating your plans for governing the realm and your desire to serve loyally. Do not merely say, “I have not studied military affairs.”

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄

中式舉人九十名

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
第十七名應存性台州府學附學生詩
第十八名王愛秀水縣學生書
第十九名王之稷衢州府學生易
第二十名朱瑞明海寧縣學附學生詩
第二十一名俞意紹興府學增廣生易
第二十二名毛子翼餘姚縣學附學生春秋
第二十三名徐公遴開化縣學生易
第二十四名陳繼良寧波府學生書
第二十五名王叔杲溫州府學增廣生禮記
===
第二十六名黃元恭寧波府學附學生易
第二十七名趙祖朝東陽縣學生詩
第二十八名嚴沉烏程縣學生書
