One would expect this search to yield men with talents like those of Li Mu, who defeated the Eastern Hu, or Chongguo, who pacified the Western Qiang. Yet those now employed do not necessarily all measure up to such men. Could it be that those making recommendations still fail to assess actual merit? This is what I mean by selecting commanders.
When those above issue no ambiguous orders, the men below will not interpret them in two ways; when action involves no doubtful undertakings, the men will not be divided in purpose. If people who were taken captive by the barbarians now come to surrender, and we kill them to claim military merit, this is more than merely inauspicious. Might our present frontier generals be guilty of this abuse? Therefore, if strict orders are issued to welcome surrender and to provide generous care and relief, people will all cherish their native soil and long to return. The enemy will inevitably become isolated and find incursions difficult. This is what I mean by welcoming those who surrender and submit.
Frontier troubles arise unpredictably, while the troops available for garrison duty are limited. Thus, when frontier counties were established in antiquity to prepare against the enemy, the people who arrived had places to live and means with which to work. Nothing would be better than to select sturdy men living near the frontier, supply them with weapons and armor, and furnish them with money and silk, so that, when at home, they…

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
習於射騎出則敢於應敵殺虜有功爵賞
及焉人自為防而家自為鬭未有不戮力
而血戰者也况近日挫其前鋒者不有明
效已乎故曰激勇敢者此也兵志曰見利
不失遇時不疑失利後時反受其殃蓋兵
凶戰危鋒刃之下死生俄頃而可起逗遛
之漸蹈猶豫之愆乎今聞徵兵之疏已下
而彼此觀望邊戍不即渡河而主將計引
者有矣令何在焉故曰速徵調者此也邊
===
城守令其責為重議者欲盡用俊彥是矣
然嘗聞之非生於其域習於其風幼而覩
焉長而安焉不見樂土而遷焉則聞絕塞
荒陬之苦辛酸動容當强蕃勁虜之至懾
駭奪氣而能乘時以立奇功哉故必隨地
授才附近求賢而後賢才樂為之用故曰
重守令者此也兵志曰法令不明賞罰不
信雖有百萬何益於用故魏侯之任樂羊
孔明之斬馬謖君子善之今之御將者纖
punctuated:
習於射騎，出則敢於應敵，殺虜有功，爵賞及焉。人自為防，而家自為鬭，未有不戮力而血戰者也。况近日挫其前鋒者，不有明效已乎？故曰「激勇敢」者，此也。《兵志》曰：「見利不失，遇時不疑。失利後時，反受其殃。」蓋兵凶戰危，鋒刃之下，死生俄頃，而可起逗遛之漸，蹈猶豫之愆乎？今聞徵兵之疏已下，而彼此觀望，邊戍不即渡河，而主將計引者有矣。令何在焉？故曰「速徵調」者，此也。

邊城守令，其責為重。議者欲盡用俊彥，是矣。然嘗聞之：非生於其域，習於其風，幼而覩焉，長而安焉，不見樂土而遷焉，則聞絕塞荒陬之苦，辛酸動容；當强蕃勁虜之至，懾駭奪氣，而能乘時以立奇功哉？故必隨地授才，附近求賢，而後賢才樂為之用。故曰「重守令」者，此也。《兵志》曰：「法令不明，賞罰不信，雖有百萬，何益於用？」故魏侯之任樂羊，孔明之斬馬謖，君子善之。今之御將者，纖
translation_en:
…become practiced in archery and horsemanship, and, when they go out, dare to meet the enemy. Those who distinguish themselves by killing enemy troops should receive rank and rewards. With each man defending himself and each household fighting for itself, none will fail to exert their utmost strength and fight to the death. Moreover, have those who recently checked the enemy vanguard not already demonstrated clear results? This is what is meant by “encouraging courage.” The Military Treatise (Bing zhi) says: “When an advantage appears, do not let it slip; when the opportunity comes, do not hesitate. Lose the advantage and miss the moment, and you will suffer the resulting calamity.” Warfare is an ominous undertaking and battle is perilous; beneath the blades, life or death is decided in an instant. How can one allow delay to take root or commit the fault of indecision? Now I hear that the memorial requesting the mobilization of troops has already been sent down, yet the parties watch one another and wait. The frontier garrisons do not promptly cross the river, and there are even commanding generals who plan to withdraw [?]. What has become of the orders? This is what is meant by “expediting mobilization.”

Prefects and magistrates in frontier towns bear weighty responsibilities. Those who argue that outstanding men should be appointed to all these posts are right. Yet I have heard this: unless a man was born in that region, became accustomed to its ways, witnessed them in childhood, grew comfortable with them in adulthood, and did not move away upon seeing more agreeable lands, hearing of the hardships of remote frontier outposts and desolate corners will move him to visible distress. When powerful foreign peoples and fierce enemies arrive, he will be terrified and lose heart. How could he seize the opportunity to accomplish extraordinary deeds? Thus, one must appoint capable men suited to each locality and seek worthy men nearby; only then will worthy and capable men gladly serve. This is what is meant by “giving due weight to prefects and magistrates.” The Military Treatise says: “If laws and orders are unclear, and rewards and punishments cannot be relied upon, what practical use is even an army of a million?” Thus, gentlemen approve of the Marquis of Wei’s employment of Yue Yang and Kongming’s execution of Ma Su. Those who command generals today, at the slightest…

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
過細舉而以文法繩之是樂羊之材弗振
也喪師失律而以私意恕之雖馬謖之敗
弗論也欲遠聽之士望風馳命蓋亦難矣
宜重撫臣之任正綱紀之體嚴賞罰之令
庶可鼓豪傑以風四方故曰明法制者此
也若足兵食設關險嚴烽堠遠間諜固將
臣事耳賈誼曰匈奴之衆不過漢一大縣
匈奴侵掠至不敬也爲天下患至亡已也
翫細娛而不圖大患非所以爲安也今之
===
虜患視誼之言何如哉夫虜如飛禽走獸
其寇也雖難逆料而其至也必有定形西
寇陝西必由花馬池以入臨鞏東寇三晉
宣大必由平虜朔州以入三關出套則侵
宣大之境入套則犯延寧之地邊氓謀士
未得高枕豈可任其去來而不求其故哉
若爲將者或事浮誇而乏驍果恩厚不結
於前法令不信於後遇敵而所守不固陳
謀而其效無成屯聚雖衆誰爲先登非止
punctuated: 過細舉，而以文法繩之，是樂羊之材弗振也；喪師失律，而以私意恕之，雖馬謖之敗弗論也。欲遠聽之士望風馳命，蓋亦難矣。宜重撫臣之任，正綱紀之體，嚴賞罰之令，庶可鼓豪傑以風四方。故曰明法制者，此也。若足兵食，設關險，嚴烽堠，遠間諜，固將臣事耳。賈誼曰：「匈奴之衆，不過漢一大縣；匈奴侵掠，至不敬也；爲天下患，至亡已也。翫細娛而不圖大患，非所以爲安也。」今之虜患，視誼之言何如哉？夫虜如飛禽走獸，其寇也雖難逆料，而其至也必有定形。西寇陝西，必由花馬池以入臨鞏；東寇三晉、宣大，必由平虜、朔州以入三關。出套則侵宣大之境，入套則犯延寧之地。邊氓謀士未得高枕，豈可任其去來而不求其故哉？若爲將者，或事浮誇而乏驍果，恩厚不結於前，法令不信於後，遇敵而所守不固，陳謀而其效無成，屯聚雖衆，誰爲先登？非止
translation_en:
…faults are minutely enumerated and commanders are constrained by legal formalities: thus the talents of a Yue Yang cannot flourish. Yet when they lose an army and violate military discipline, they are pardoned out of personal partiality; even a defeat such as Ma Su’s goes unpunished. To expect men who hear of this from afar to hasten to obey at the mere news of a summons would indeed be difficult. The responsibilities of the grand coordinators should be given greater weight, the structure of discipline set right, and the rules governing rewards and punishments strictly enforced. This might stir outstanding men to action and influence all quarters. This is what is meant by making laws and institutions clear. As for ensuring adequate troops and provisions, establishing strategic defenses at the passes, maintaining strict vigilance at beacon posts, and sending spies far afield, these are simply the duties of military commanders.

Jia Yi said: “The multitude of the Xiongnu amounts to no more than the population of one large Han county. Their invasions and plundering show the utmost disrespect, and the trouble they cause the realm is utterly unending. To indulge in petty amusements without planning against a great danger is no way to secure peace.” How does the present danger from the northern foes compare with Jia Yi’s words? These foes are like flying birds and running beasts: although their raids are difficult to predict, their approaches necessarily follow fixed patterns. When they raid Shaanxi to the west, they must pass through Huamachi to enter Lin and Gong; when they raid Sanjin, Xuan, and Da to the east, they must pass through Pinglu and Shuozhou to enter the Three Passes. When they leave the Hetao region, they invade the territory of Xuan and Da; when they enter it, they attack the lands of Yan and Ning. The border population and those devising strategy cannot yet sleep in peace. How could we allow the enemy to come and go without investigating the reasons?

If commanders devote themselves to empty boasting and lack valor and resolution, if they have not first bound their men to themselves through generous kindness and subsequently fail to make their orders credible, if their defenses prove insecure when they meet the enemy and their proposed plans achieve nothing, then, however many troops they assemble, who will be first to scale the enemy’s walls? It is not merely…

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
費財玩寇之弊亦有不戢自焚之災非計
之得也况今秋邊報雖息而詭計無端若
必滅跡掃塵以立昭明之功謀國者尤當
知所慎矣雖然宣王中興飭武而吉召揚
烈漢武赫然内憤而衛霍流聲况今
聖天子在上仁恩沾被神武布昭中興之治過
周宣遠甚乘今之時得地之便而又上下
同心以盡人謀省不急之費撫久疲之民
攺示寰中銳意邊域則精神所至事必集
===
焉兵强財足氣盛勢全猛將謀臣感激思
奮將見繫單于於闕下走可汗於窮荒頌
獻平胡以紓
皇上西北之憂者端有期矣
punctuated: 費財玩寇之弊，亦有不戢自焚之災，非計之得也。况今秋邊報雖息，而詭計無端，若必滅跡掃塵，以立昭明之功，謀國者尤當知所慎矣。雖然，宣王中興，飭武而吉召揚烈；漢武赫然内憤，而衛霍流聲。况今聖天子在上，仁恩沾被，神武布昭，中興之治過周宣遠甚。乘今之時，得地之便，而又上下同心，以盡人謀，省不急之費，撫久疲之民，攺示寰中，銳意邊域，則精神所至，事必集焉。兵强財足，氣盛勢全，猛將謀臣感激思奮，將見繫單于於闕下，走可汗於窮荒，頌獻平胡，以紓皇上西北之憂者，端有期矣。
translation_en:
…the abuses of wasting resources and treating the enemy lightly, but also the calamity of failing to restrain arms and thereby bringing destruction upon oneself. This is no sound strategy. Moreover, although reports of frontier alarms have ceased this autumn, the enemy’s devious schemes have no end. If we insist on erasing every trace and sweeping away all dust of their incursions to establish illustrious achievements, those who plan for the state must be especially mindful of what demands caution.

Nevertheless, when King Xuan restored the Zhou, he put military affairs in order, and Ji and Shao displayed their achievements; when Emperor Wu of Han blazed with indignation, Wei and Huo won lasting renown. How much more is possible now, with our sage Son of Heaven above us! His benevolent favor reaches everywhere, and his divine martial prowess shines abroad. The government of this restoration far surpasses that of King Xuan of Zhou. If we seize the present opportunity and the advantages of terrain, if those above and below unite their purposes and exert human ingenuity to the utmost, reduce nonessential expenditure, comfort the long-exhausted people, manifest reform throughout the realm [?], and concentrate our resolve on the frontier regions, then wherever our spirit and energy are directed, affairs will surely succeed. With strong troops, ample resources, high morale, and our strategic strength intact, valiant generals and resourceful ministers will be stirred with gratitude and eager to exert themselves. We shall then see the chanyu bound beneath the palace gate towers and the khan driven into the remotest wilderness. The day when an ode celebrating the pacification of the Hu is presented, relieving His Majesty’s anxiety over the northwest, will surely come.

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
浙江鄉試錄後序
嘉靖二十有二年癸卯秋八
月浙江省臣例舉鄉試事成
錄所選士九十人及其文二
十一篇以
獻雍以執事當敘諸末簡于是
作而言曰大哉人文之盛乎
===
惟
皇建極惟士乃興故雲漢章天俊
髦所以延譽菁莪闡化英乂
所以樂成蓋神化潛孚氣類
響應有必然者肆多士之呈
藝而興也皆鴻材利器通經
雅詞下抒江海之靈上煥斗
punctuated:
浙江鄉試錄後序

嘉靖二十有二年癸卯秋八月，浙江省臣例舉鄉試，事成，錄所選士九十人及其文二十一篇以獻。雍以執事，當敘諸末簡，于是作而言曰：「大哉，人文之盛乎！惟皇建極，惟士乃興。故雲漢章天，俊髦所以延譽；菁莪闡化，英乂所以樂成。蓋神化潛孚，氣類響應，有必然者。肆多士之呈藝而興也，皆鴻材利器，通經雅詞，下抒江海之靈，上煥斗
translation_en:
Postface to the Record of the Zhejiang Provincial Examination

In the eighth month of autumn in the guimao year, the twenty-second year of Jiajing [1543], the provincial officials of Zhejiang conducted the Provincial Examination according to established practice. When it was completed, they compiled the names of the ninety selected scholars and twenty-one of their compositions for presentation to the throne. I, Yong, having served in the proceedings, was charged with writing a postface at the end of the record. I therefore rose and said:

“Great indeed is the flourishing of literary culture! When the sovereign establishes the supreme standard, scholars rise to prominence. Thus, as the Milky Way adorns the heavens, outstanding talents gain widespread renown; as ‘Luxuriant Southernwood’ unfolds its civilizing influence, men of exceptional ability rejoice in their cultivation and achievement. For the transforming influence works imperceptibly, and those of kindred disposition respond in resonance: this is inevitable. Thus the many scholars who have displayed their accomplishments and risen to distinction are all great talents and keen instruments, versed in the Classics and elegant in expression. Below, they give expression to the spiritual potency of rivers and seas; above, they enhance the radiance of the Dipper …

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
牛之曜積于藏脩而徵于遴
選彬彬稱甚盛焉故有司錄
其名氏以廣其聞錄其文詞
以顯其學而又宴之鹿鳴以
樂其賢升之
天府以達其用則多士之拔茅
升階鴻儀鳳翽斯有時矣然
===
亦因鹿鳴而思所以爲嘉賓
者乎彼固皆育于菁莪作于
雲漢者也當周之時其政尚
文士生其間宜文習盛麗樸
厚稍漓然王者篤禮意而求
大道則曰德音孔昭視民不
恌君子是則是傚而嘉賓樂
punctuated:
牛之曜，積于藏脩而徵于遴選，彬彬稱甚盛焉。故有司錄其名氏以廣其聞，錄其文詞以顯其學，而又宴之鹿鳴以樂其賢，升之天府以達其用，則多士之拔茅升階、鴻儀鳳翽，斯有時矣。
然亦因鹿鳴而思所以爲嘉賓者乎？彼固皆育于菁莪、作于雲漢者也。當周之時，其政尚文，士生其間，宜文習盛麗，樸厚稍漓。然王者篤禮意而求大道，則曰：「德音孔昭，視民不恌，君子是則是傚。」而嘉賓樂
translation_en:
… the radiance of the Ox constellation. Cultivated through sustained study, their accomplishments are demonstrated in selection; their refinement and substance are acclaimed as flourishing indeed. Thus the responsible officials record their names to spread their reputation and record their compositions to make their learning manifest. They further entertain them at the Deer Cry banquet to rejoice in their worthiness, and advance them to the imperial capital so that their talents may be put to use. The time will then come for these many scholars to rise together like linked roots of pulled-up couch grass, to ascend the steps of office, and to display the bearing of wild geese and the rustling wings of phoenixes.
Yet, prompted by the Deer Cry, do they also reflect on what it means to be worthy guests? They have all been nurtured through the care celebrated in Luxuriant Southernwood (Jing E) and inspired by the Cloudy Han (Yun Han). In the Zhou era, government esteemed cultural refinement. Scholars born into that age naturally developed splendid and elaborate literary practices, while simplicity and sincerity gradually diminished. Yet the kings deepened the spirit of ritual propriety and sought the Great Way, saying: “His virtuous reputation is most illustrious; he shows the people how not to be frivolous. The gentleman takes him as his rule and model.” And the worthy guests delighted in …

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
治世而願明主亦曰民之質
矣日用飲食羣黎百姓徧爲
爾德夫厚典惇禮憲世淑民
非至德其曷成之故知周之
君以望乎臣周之臣以承乎
君者一惟純德以為本而渾
化以為功其所謂文特用救
===
夏商之敝焉爾而非所以爲
教也今多士涵濡
聖化光顯藝材旣定其論將承其
官君子望之小民竢之茂哉
稱嘉賓矣母乃盛麗之習而
樸厚之漓乎夫雕文刻鏤傷
農事者也錦繡纂組害女紅
punctuated:
治世而願明主，亦曰：「民之質矣，日用飲食。羣黎百姓，徧爲爾德。」夫厚典惇禮，憲世淑民，非至德其曷成之？故知周之君以望乎臣，周之臣以承乎君者，一惟純德以為本，而渾化以為功。其所謂文，特用救夏商之敝焉爾，而非所以爲教也。
今多士涵濡聖化，光顯藝材，旣定其論，將承其官。君子望之，小民竢之，茂哉，稱嘉賓矣！母乃盛麗之習，而樸厚之漓乎？夫雕文刻鏤，傷農事者也；錦繡纂組，害女紅
translation_en:
…a well-governed age and hope for an enlightened ruler. It is also said: “The people’s substance lies in their daily food and drink. The multitude of common people everywhere follows your virtue.” To give weight to institutions and earnest attention to ritual, to set an example for the age and improve the people—how could these be accomplished without consummate virtue? Thus we know that what the rulers of Zhou expected of their ministers, and what the ministers of Zhou offered in service to their rulers, rested wholly upon pure virtue as its foundation and took thorough moral transformation as its achievement. What they called cultural refinement served merely to remedy the failings of Xia and Shang; it was not the means by which they taught the people.
Now the many scholars, steeped in the sage ruler’s transforming influence, have brilliantly displayed their literary skills and abilities. Their assessments have been settled, and they will take up their offices. Gentlemen look to them with expectation, and the common people await them. How splendid—to be acclaimed as honored guests! Yet might they have acquired habits of ornate magnificence while allowing their simplicity and sincerity to diminish? Patterned carving and engraving impair agricultural work; brocades, embroidery, and ornamental braiding impair women’s textile work…

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
者也煩禮縟儀虛談偽行戕
士德者也農事傷則饑之本
也女紅害則寒之原也士德
戕則靡之極也可弗慎與夫
周之詩有曰豈弟曰顯允曰
馮翼曰孝德曰文武曰肅雝
皆厚于其德而不漓者也有
===
曰詭隨曰夸毗曰彊禦曰掊
克曰忮忒曰譖背曰回遹皆
習于其文而流焉者也多士
其鑒審于玆如農之植本務
滋而其積有茨也如織之恤
緯務績而其束有戋也斯昭
德塞違以臨示百姓而民不
punctuated: 者也。煩禮縟儀、虛談偽行，戕士德者也。農事傷，則饑之本也；女紅害，則寒之原也；士德戕，則靡之極也。可弗慎與？夫周之詩，有曰豈弟，曰顯允，曰馮翼，曰孝德，曰文武，曰肅雝，皆厚于其德而不漓者也。有曰詭隨，曰夸毗，曰彊禦，曰掊克，曰忮忒，曰譖背，曰回遹，皆習于其文而流焉者也。多士其鑒審于玆，如農之植本，務滋而其積有茨也；如織之恤緯，務績而其束有戋也。斯昭德塞違，以臨示百姓，而民不
translation_en:
…are what harm women’s textile work. Elaborate rites and excessive ceremony, empty talk and false conduct are what destroy scholars’ virtue. Injury to farming is the root of hunger; harm to women’s textile work is the source of cold; the destruction of scholars’ virtue is the utmost degeneration. Can one fail to exercise caution?

The Poetry of the Zhou speaks of being amiable and easygoing, illustrious and trustworthy, supportive and helpful, filial and virtuous, accomplished in civil and military affairs, reverent and harmonious. These all describe those whose virtue is substantial and undiluted. It also speaks of obsequious compliance, groveling flattery, domineering force, grasping exploitation, malicious perversity, slanderous betrayal, and devious crookedness. These all describe those who become practiced in outward refinement and drift into excess.

You scholars should carefully examine these examples as a mirror. Be like farmers who plant roots and strive to nourish them until their accumulated harvest rises in heaps; be like weavers who attend to the weft and strive at their work until their bundles of silk are abundant. Thus you will make virtue manifest and check wrongdoing, overseeing and instructing the common people, so that the people do not…

title: 嘉靖二十二年浙江鄉試錄
text:
瑜以表儀位著而君子法之
爲龍爲光爲圭爲璋儼然
盛世之嘉賓焉豈不韙哉如以
其文而已也吾懼其或流而
靡也其可以弗慎與其可以
弗慎與
廣東廣州府順德縣儒學教
===
諭陳雍謹序
punctuated:
瑜，以表儀位著，而君子法之，爲龍爲光，爲圭爲璋，儼然盛世之嘉賓焉，豈不韙哉？如以其文而已也，吾懼其或流而靡也。其可以弗慎與？其可以弗慎與？
廣東廣州府順德縣儒學教諭陳雍謹序。
translation_en:
… transgress [?]. They stand prominently as models, and gentlemen emulate them; they bring favor and radiance, becoming like gui and zhang jade tablets, dignified, honored guests of a flourishing age. Would this not be admirable? If, however, they rely on literary accomplishment alone, I fear that they may drift into frivolity. How could they fail to be vigilant? How could they fail to be vigilant?
Preface respectfully composed by Chen Yong, Instructor in the Confucian School of Shunde County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong.
